description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting within the application, specifically for converting strings to camelCase and Title Case for display purposes.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, collapsing multiple whitespace, and trimming.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, replacing delimiters with spaces, collapsing spaces, and capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes, while preserving accented characters.
